name: Steam Deck Pack
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: Steam Deck controller pack: built-in white ABXY and L1/L2/R1/R2 prompts, Steam Input gyro/trackpad camera, minimal settings under Pause > Options > Steam Deck, and isolated 16:10 startup profiles.

settings.name: Invert mouse Y
settings.description: Applied before the game's own controller invert setting.

conflicts.reason: Steam Deck Pack already paints the controller button icons.
Both mods consume the same mouse camera input.
